stem: What can the reader conclude from the last paragraph of each selection?

options.label: F
options.text: One author has been affected by events in the selection more than the other.

options.label: G
options.text: Both authors plan to make significant changes in their lives.

options.label: H
options.text: One author regrets not having made a more sincere effort to be successful.

options.label: J
options.text: Both authors have had meaningful experiences.
